'''Ijol''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Tirahnn (star)|Tirahnn]], the [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn system's]] [[Star/Legends|sun]].<ref name="Threat" /> The planet, along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|system]], was situated in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]]<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Zeemacht Cluster/Legends|Zeemacht Cluster]]<ref name="Threat" /> along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which served as the dividing line between the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Atlas" /> By [[17,000 BBY]], Ijol's system also resided along a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route, that linked it to the [[Filordis system/Legends|Filordis]] and [[Ktil system/Legends|Ktil systems]], that ceased to exist by [[3976 BBY]].<ref name="DeadRoute">Per ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', by approximately [[17,000 BBY]] the [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn system]], and therefore Ijol, was on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' shows linked it to the [[Filordis system/Legends|Filordis]] and [[Ktil system/Legends|Ktil systems]]. Per ''The Essential Atlas'', that route had ceased to exist by [[3976 BBY]].</ref> Ijol was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with twenty-four [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="Threat" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ijol was first introduced in "[[Triplet Threat]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure written by [[Jason Fry]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[January 22]], [[2004]].<ref name="Threat" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed the Tirahnn system, and therefore Ijol, in grid square N-8.<ref name="Atlas" />
